baseline.direction: the committed setting; everything else is read against it

baseline_repeat.direction: same setting, different thread count: the same-instrument difference, which bounds what an arm has to beat to mean anything

strict_bubble.direction: merge only near-identical bubbles. Expect more, shorter contigs and less lineage fusion; breadth may fall

no_bubble.direction: no bubble merging at all. The extreme of keeping paths apart

lax_bubble.direction: merge bubbles down to 90% similarity. THE ABSORPTION ARM: expect longer contigs, more mosaics, and a residue that shrinks wrongly

keep_thin.direction: keep low-depth unitigs. Expect more low-depth contigs and more junk

keep_local.direction: keep low-coverage local branches that the defaults remove

prune_hard.direction: prune harder. Expect a larger residue and little change deep down

no_rescue.direction: remove both low-coverage rescue mechanisms. The least-path-rescue end

meta_sensitive.direction: the preset the residue assembly used, never compared to the default until now. NOT a path arm: it also sets --min-count 1, a lever this project already measured as dead, so it is reported separately and no path conclusion rests on it
